scope.geography: Bay Area first; Cleveland/Ohio second; nationwide third. Only specific official university/institution pages currently labeled open or 'Apply Today!' were selected; no equally strong verified nationwide posting displaced the local choices.
scope.selection_rule: Checked October 30, 2026 against exact official institution postings; past ASAP/July 2026 starts flagged. A late-2026 PhD completion is not an automatic exclusion. No unpublished research information included.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Scholar — Scalable hPSC-derived 3D Tissue Models
jobs.company: Stanford University — Maneesh Kumar Misra Lab
jobs.term: One year; flexible start, rolling review

salary.note: Stanford FY27 postdoc minimum stated on official posting

jobs.posting_status: Official Stanford Open Postdoctoral Position page posted October 19, 2026 and live October 30; explicitly encourages applicants about to submit a PhD thesis. New to shortlist.
jobs.job_description: Develop, optimize and characterize scalable human pluripotent stem cell-derived 3D tissues for disease modeling and drug discovery, with single-cell and immune analysis.
key_must_have_requirements: Relevant PhD or thesis nearing submission
Experience in 3D cell models, tissue engineering, microphysiological systems or microfluidics
Strong scientific publication record
CV, cover letter and three references
jobs.why_good_match: Excellent technology fit in human tissue modeling and microfluidics, flexible start, and explicit openness to near-graduation applicants.
likely_gaps: hPSC directed differentiation and non-intestinal tissue models may be unfamiliar
Immune repertoire, CRISPR and human immune assays are additional listed skills
jobs.tailor: Lead with public human tissue-model engineering, rigorous assay characterization and cross-disciplinary methods; describe concrete hPSC exposure accurately.
jobs.immediate_action: Email tailored CV, cover letter and three referees to the official contact; propose a realistic early-2027 start.
